caption: The drawing depicts a shield-shaped object with a dark metallic appearance positioned in the center of a plain, off-white background. The shield frame encloses a design featuring a central circular hub from which six straight spokes radiate outward, intersecting at the hub and extending to the frame. Three of the spokes terminate in solid circles, while the remaining three spoke ends are flat. Along the inner edge of the shield’s border, raised capital letters spell out the words “ENTERPRISE FIRE CO. PHILADELPHIA” following the arc of the top, left, and right sides. The drawing is rendered in shades of dark gray and black, with some shading to create a sense of depth and texture. A small, handwritten signature reading "Syd A. Towkist 41" appears on the lower right side just beneath the shield. There are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Trivet
